text:
tom_support: heads-up — raised a P1 from support: AsterBio pilot can't complete onboarding, SSO returns 403 during token exchange. Customers blocked from test users. renewal touchpoint in 5 weeks.

anna_csm: thanks for the ping. can you paste the exact error and which env? we need impact statement for AMs.

tom_support: prod. error: `oauth/token exchange failed: 403 forbidden (invalid audience)` — we see assertion with aud `https://auth.redwood.internal` vs expected `https://api.redwood.ai`. Started after yesterday's auth key rotate.

raj_se: sounds like audience mismatch to me. @deploy-bot pls fetch last rotate id and whether key aliases were updated.

deploy-bot: last rotation id: rot-20260310-37, executed 2026-03-10T04:11:02Z. PR: https://git.internal/auth-service/pull/462. Alias mapping updated: primary -> rot-37.

anna_csm: immediate asks: (1) prepare a customer-facing note acknowledging impact + ETA, (2) ops try a rollback test in staging, (3) AM notified of renewal risk. TOM — can you draft the first note? Raj — lead rollback validation. Sophie — I'll loop in AMs.

tom_support: Drafting: "Hi <X>, apologies — we're investigating an authentication mismatch affecting SSO for some pilot users. We're running a test rollback and expect either a fix or a brief mitigation within 90 minutes. We'll update at T+60." keep?

anna_csm: good start. Add explicit impact: "Pilot AsterBio: test users unable to finish onboarding; production UI blocked for test group." Also offer temporary access workaround (scoped API keys) and call option if they want to join.

raj_se: prefer not to ask customer to re-issue assertions. ops will run controlled rollback in staging first. ETA 30m for staging validation.

sophie_am: I'll notify AsterBio AM and flag renewal cadence. Suggest we offer a one-hour dedicated enablement slot after resolution to rebuild confidence.

tom_support: adding to note: "If you'd like immediate access we can create scoped API keys for your test users; tell us which emails."

deploy-bot: staging rollback applied at 2026-03-11T15:05:12Z, job rot-rollback-3921.

raj_se: staging rollback validated — SSO flows succeed with previous key. plan: fast rollback in prod during a 2-min window. ops requests CS approval to notify customer of brief maintenance.

anna_csm: CS approves 2-min window. Sophie — please OK with AM and ask if they prefer scheduled downtime or immediate. I'll prep comms.

sophie_am: AM prefers immediate fix; customer standing by. go ahead.

tom_support: performing prod rollback now. will post when green.

deploy-bot: prod rollback job started 2026-03-11T15:35:03Z job-id 99211.

tom_support: prod back to green. verified login flow and customer confirmed in call.

anna_csm: great. next actions: 1) postmortem within 48h (owner: raj_se), 2) AM one-pager summarizing impact + mitigation (owner: sophie_am), 3) update onboarding runbook with SSO quick-check (owner: anna_csm).

raj_se: will run postmortem and include exact rollback commands, validation checklist, and test vectors for SAML audiences.

tom_support: created ticket CSUP-8827 "AsterBio SSO 403 after key rotation" with logs and rollback artifacts.

anna_csm: please capture customer feedback on communication tone and include whether they want preventative weekly syncs before renewal. Sophie, loop me once AM note ready and I'll tailor messaging for renewal execs. thanks team :thumbsup:

sophie_am: on it — will share draft in 1 hour.
